text:
Alex Chen: quick drop — assembling a one-page on-call + CS macro playbook for live incidents (embeddings/timeouts/latency spikes). putting things here so agents can copy/paste during a page. :rotating_light:

Maya Ruiz: love it. can we include: a) customer-facing high-severity template, b) short triage checklist for agents, c) handoff notes for next on-call?

Samir Patel: adding a small distinction in macros — "Service degraded" vs "Partial outage". keep messages 1–3 sentences. will also link runbooks. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedding-timeouts (internal)

IncidentBot: Incident 2145678890 created — responders: Jordan - SRE, Samir Patel, Casey (CS). Bridge: #incident-2145678890-live. Severity: high. :rotating_light:

Casey (CS): CUSTOMER-FACING — HIGH SEVERITY (copy into Zendesk/Intercom)

"Hi {{customer_name}},

We’re currently seeing an issue affecting embeddings in US-WEST-2 which may cause timeouts or higher latency for some requests. Our engineers are actively investigating and we’ll provide updates every 30 minutes.

Impact: some embedding requests may fail or take longer than usual.
What we’re doing: triaging, failing over traffic to healthy replicas, and applying mitigations to reduce errors.

ETA for next update: {{next_update_in_minutes}} minutes.

We know this impacts your workflows and we appreciate your patience — we’ll follow up with a full post-incident report.

— Redwood Support
"

Elena (Support): INTERNAL ACK/INITIAL TRIAGE macro (paste into internal CS thread/email)

"Acknowledged — engineering is investigating. Please collect: account IDs impacted, recent request IDs (if available), sample logs/snapshots, and whether customers have attempted retries. If customer needs immediate mitigation, offer temporary routing to a different region or model version (if allowed). Escalate to SRE after initial data collection.

Suggested turnaround: 5–10 min for initial customer ack.
"

Jordan - SRE: SRE TRIAGE CHECKLIST (agents / oncall)

"1) Confirm the alert and page context (alert rule, symptom).
2) Check control plane / scheduler health: `curl -sS https://controlplane.internal/health`
3) Check runtime logs for the model pool: `kubectl -n inference logs deployment/runtime --tail=200`
4) Verify model worker health and queue lengths in Grafana (dashboard: model-pools / queue-lengths).
5) Check KV cache evictions and prefix hits. If eviction spike, consider cache warming or temporary cache bypass.
6) If embedding timeouts, scale up replica count on the dedicated pool OR failover route to secondary pool.
7) Apply temporary rate-limiting on non-critical routes to protect latency-sensitive traffic.
8) Post a short status update and mitigation steps to customers and internal channels.

Commands:```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDCRED" https://api.redwood.internal/health | jq 
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/runtime -c runtime --tail=250
```
"

Samir Patel: ZENDESK MACROS (short, copyable)

"Macro: Acknowledge - Investigating
Body:
Hi {{ticket.requester.name}},

Thanks for reporting this. We’re currently investigating an issue that may affect embeddings for some customers. Our engineering team is working on a fix — we’ll follow up with an update within 30 minutes.

If you can, please send a sample request ID or timestamp of the failing request — it helps debugging.

Best,
Redwood Support
"

"Macro: Temporary Mitigation Applied
Body:
Hi {{ticket.requester.name}},

We’ve applied a temporary mitigation (rerouting requests to a healthy pool / increased replicas). You may see reduced errors now. Please retry and let us know if you still see failures. We’ll keep monitoring and will update when a permanent fix is in place.

— Redwood Support
"

"Macro: Post-Incident Follow-up
Body:
Hi {{ticket.requester.name}},

The incident affecting embeddings in {{region}} has been resolved. We implemented {short mitigation}. A full root cause analysis will be posted to our status page and we can share the RCA in this thread when available.

If you have follow-ups or saw any lingering issues, please reply here.

Thanks for your patience — Redwood Support
"

Samir Patel: INTERCOM PROACTIVE REACH-OUT (short)

"Hi {{name}}, we wanted to let you know we’re investigating elevated errors for embeddings in your region. Engineers are on it; we’ll keep you updated. If you rely on a time-sensitive job, consider delaying retries until we confirm stability.
"

Maya Ruiz: STATUS PAGE UPDATE TEMPLATE (suggest cadence every 30 min for high severity)

"Status page headline: Partial degradation of embeddings in US-WEST-2 (Investigating)

Public update body:
We are investigating reports of timeouts and increased latency for embeddings in US-WEST-2. Some requests may fail or be slower than usual. Our engineers are actively working on diagnosis and mitigation.

Customer impact: Some users may experience failures or timeouts for embedding generation.
Next update: in 30 minutes or earlier as new info becomes available.

Internal note: update cadence = 30m until mitigation in place; after mitigation reduce to 60m and then final RCA postmortem once complete.
"

Jordan - SRE: ON-CALL HANDOFF TEMPLATE (to paste into next shift)

"Handoff summary: Incident 2145678890 — embeddings degraded in US-WEST-2. Current status: mitigation applied (traffic partially rerouted to pool B). Error rate trending down (X% -> Y%).
Actions taken: scaled pool A +2 replicas; applied temporary routing rule; cache warmed for hot prefixes.
Open tasks: validate long-term fix for KV eviction; monitor for regression for next 2 hours; confirm no backfill jobs overloaded.
Watch items: queue length > 500, error rate > 2%.
Contacts: Samir Patel (lead SRE), Casey (CS lead).
Next update cadence: 30m.
"

Casey (CS): PHONE/ESCALATION SCRIPT (short)

"Intro: Hi {{contact_name}}, this is Casey from Redwood Support. We’re calling about issue impacting embeddings in your region. Quick summary: some request timeouts/latency; we’ve applied a mitigation and are monitoring.

If they ask for ETA: give next update window and offer temporary workarounds (region routing, reduce batch size).
If they want compensation/escalation: escalate to account exec + legal per company policy.
"

Elena (Support): TL;DR customer macro (non-technical)

"We’re aware of an issue affecting embeddings for some customers in US-WEST-2. Our engineers are working on it and we expect improved performance soon. We’ll follow up with a full update.
"

Alex Chen: final: please copy/paste these into Zendesk as macros and keep the statuspage cadence tight. I’ll sync these into /docs/incidents/quickplaybook.md and add screenshots of runbook steps. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
